Magnetic design with replaceable batteries ( 1 battery and 1 magnet ( D8x2 mm Round Magnet ) included ) | Energy Efficient
Easy Operation | Adjustable lighting modes for different needs
This product is intended for ages 14 and up and is not suitable for use in any children's products, toys, or household items intended for children.
This product contains small parts and poses a choking hazard. Do not ingest. If accidentally swallowed, seek immediate medical attention. Keep out of reach of children.
Please be aware that the device is programmed to automatically enter sleep mode after 10 minutes of operation.
